content: Authentic quote plus wrong subject/column/unit or numeric substring is accepted as verified complete. Four owning-entry counterexamples reproduce unsupported claims.

Concentration fact with no verified unit is complete; reproduced with a unitless three-column source, and submitted real fact-002 has units=[] and value 0.05. Preserve numeric evidence but require source-supported unit/conditions or unknown/partial.
Reading both requested editions does not ensure answer coverage: a model returning only the 2012 claim is still complete for a two-edition comparison.
Post guard capture failure/drift is written to the report but run_answer returns normally; CLI prints Answer OK. Failure must reject after terminal evidence is saved.
Connection acquisition precedes the resource/terminal try boundary. PG connection TimeoutError skips post identity collection and leaves no runtime terminal report.
